support_spans: Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen demonstrated a well-defined hypodense lesion measuring 4.6 × 3.4 cm with fat density in the sigmoid-colon wall protruding into the lumen, along with invagination of the descending colon into the sigmoid colon consistent with intussusception
